title: Schedule past-time re-queue advance fix
desc: Eye schedule: when next_fire <= now after a missed/unconfirmed run, advance execute_at by additional intervals until next_fire > now before re-queuing. Prevents indefinite replay of past-time triggers.
steps: Bug: recurring schedule (e.g. 00:00 daily) re-queues same trigger forever when run_count not incremented -- next_fire stays in the past, Eye delivers identical trigger hundreds of times sequentially.
Root cause: after fire, next_fire = last_fire + interval. If confirmation missed, next_fire <= now, so Eye immediately re-queues without advancing.
Fix: after computing next_fire = last_fire + interval, loop: while (next_fire <= now) next_fire += interval. Write advanced next_fire back to queue.
